decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist associated with the title 'With a Little Help from My Friends'. The source documents identify three distinct artists who have released works with this exact title: 1) 'the Beatles' (D1S1), who performed the original song; 2) 'Joe Cocker' (D1S6, D4S1, D5S1), who released a hit single and a debut album with this title; and 3) 'Lu Elliott' (D7S5), who released a jazz album with this title. 'Ringo Starr' and 'Billy Shears' are rejected because they are the intended vocalist/character for the Beatles' version, not the primary artist of the work itself, and the prompt distinguishes between the artist (band) and the performer. 'The Grease Band' is the backing group for Cocker, not the primary artist. Other candidates like Lennon/McCartney are songwriters, not the performing artists of the specific recordings mentioned.
